column1: # Hand-off perturbation demo sweep — ONE row per model category of the
# benchmark table, because the campaign multiplies by 19 perturbation arms and
# the full 15-row table would be 15,400 cells.
#   pdm_closed                  rule-based   (privileged, no checkpoint)
#   diffusiondrive              IL
#   recogdrive_rl               RLFT
#   recogdrive_il               the SAME architecture BEFORE the RL stage --
#                               the before/after pair the paper's comparison
#                               needs, and cheap here because a 2B planner
#                               shares a card with the renderer.
#   diffusiondrive_beyonddrive  augmentation
# The world-model row is NOT here. It is simwam, and it lives in
# models_simwam.tsv because it needs a two-card pod: SimWAM measured 13.7 GiB of
# its own, and these workers share ONE card between the renderer and the
# rollout, which leaves nothing like that much. resworld held the slot until
# 2026-09-06 and was replaced at the user's instruction.
# Three of the four expose a CANDIDATE SET (trajectory_coarse + scores), which
# is what a trajectory-distribution plot is made of: pdm_closed and both
# diffusiondrive rows. recogdrive emits a single trajectory, and its
# plan_records.json says so with a null candidate field rather than an absent
# one.
pdm_closed
diffusiondrive
recogdrive_rl
recogdrive_il
diffusiondrive_beyonddrive
